The "Sarabun" Thai font will be crucial.

I will incorporate the original `Sarabun` font, and the color scheme. Next, I'll figure out the Recharts configurations. I'm choosing the bar and line charts for data representation. I'll stick with the CDN for Tailwind.

I'm now prioritizing the UI. I've decided to make a reusable `Filter` component, as it's used across multiple pages. I'm also going to consider consolidating smaller generic UI components, and the folder structure. I'm using `lucide-react` for icons and I'll include the necessary Tailwind configuration.

I'm now focusing on creating the Recharts components to visualize the data. I'm choosing bar and line charts to clearly represent the data, making them consistent with the dashboard's design. My priority is to integrate them seamlessly into the overall user interface while ensuring they're responsive and easy to understand.
